title: Minecraft Bow
blurb: A creak of tension and the snap of release. Minecraft's bow gives you almost no feedback beyond this half-second sound and a small animation, so players learn to time a full draw entirely by ear: pull, listen, release, hope. Skeletons use exactly the same noise against you, which is why hearing it in a dark cave means you are already being shot at from somewhere you cannot see. In edits it works as a clean, dry launch sting for anything fired, thrown, or sent off into the distance.
origin: The bow release sound from Minecraft.
